slots.jd.software-company.about:
About the role
Tandem Software is growing, and so is the number of projects we run. We need a Project Manager who keeps work moving with clear plans, honest status updates and no surprises. You'll work with engineering, product and outside vendors to get projects across the line and closed out properly. This is a hybrid role based in Boston.
slots.jd.software-company.duties:
What you'll do
- Own project close-out: confirm deliverables, collect sign-offs and capture lessons learned
- Run the change request process, from intake and impact review through to approval
- Keep risk and issue logs current, with a clear owner and next step for every item
- Spot blockers early, escalate them and help teams work through them
- Share regular status updates with stakeholders across the company
slots.jd.software-company.needs:
What we're looking for
- 3 or more years of experience as a project manager or in a similar role
- Hands-on experience with Jira and Asana
- Solid resource planning and vendor negotiation skills
- Clear stakeholder communication and disciplined change control
- Required: Project Practitioner Certificate
- Preferred: Agile Delivery Certificate
slots.r1.b1: Runs budget reviews using resource planning to match staffing to project demand, cutting budget variance by 50 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Closes out projects with status reporting that confirms deliverables, open items and sign-offs before handover to operations.
slots.r1.b3: Tracks schedules and milestones across vendor deliverables, using vendor negotiation to reset late commitments and reducing missed milestones by 55 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Coordinates vendor work in Asana, assigning tasks, due dates and owners so handoffs between vendors and internal teams stay visible.
slots.r1.i1: Manages projects at Granite Ridge, keeping risk and issue logs current so problems are owned, escalated and resolved before they affect delivery.
slots.r1.i2: Leads project close-out at Granite Ridge, confirming deliverables are accepted, records are archived and lessons are captured for the next project.
slots.r2.b1: Maintained risk registers for active projects, logging issues with owners and due dates, which reduced overdue issue items by 15 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Logged and tracked change requests in Smartsheet, routing each one for impact review and approval before scope changes reached the team.
slots.r2.b3: Prepared budget reviews from Microsoft Project cost data, flagging overruns early and helping reduce project spend by 10 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Closed out completed projects in Jira by verifying that all tickets were resolved, documented and signed off by stakeholders.
slots.r2.i1: Supported project close-out at Kestrel Works, tracking final deliverables, sign-offs and handover documents for each completed project.
slots.r2.i2: Coordinated change requests at Kestrel Works, recording each request, its impact and its approval status for the project team.
slots.summary.1: Project management specialist with about 3 years of experience owning a recurring delivery process from initial request to completion. Uses status reporting, Smartsheet and vendor negotiation to keep scope, schedule and suppliers aligned.
slots.summary.2: Specialist project management professional with about 3 years of experience running a repeatable process from request through completion. Brings vendor negotiation, Smartsheet tracking and clear status reporting to keep work moving and stakeholders informed.
